paite: Huan hiaite apipute uh inkote lak a alupente ahi ua, kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai a kei hon zuite khangthu suina ahi.
heading: Saltanna A Kipan A Hong Kik Nawnte
english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

paite: Phinehas tapate lak ah, Gershom: Ithamar tapate lak ah Daniel: David tapate lak ah, Hattush,
english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

paite: Shekaniah tapate lak ah; Parosh tapate lak ah, Zekariah: amah toh pasalte khangthu suina a suikhawmte zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi.
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.

paite: Pahath-moab tapate lak ah, Elihoenai Zerahiah tapa; huan amah toh pasal zanihte.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

paite: Shekaniah tapate lak ah, Jahaziel tapa; amah toh pasal zathumte.
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

paite: Adin tapate lak ah, Jonathan tapa Ebed; amah toh pasal sawmngate.
english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

paite: Elam tapate lak ah, Athaliah tapa Jeshaiah; amah toh pasal sawmsagihte.
english: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

paite: Shephatiah tapate, Mikael tapa Zebadiah; amah toh pasal sawmgiatte.
english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

paite: Joab tapate lak ah, Jehiel tapa Obadiah; amah toh pasal zanih sawm-le-giatte.
english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

paite: Shelomith tapate lak ah, Josiphiah tapa; amah toh pasal zakhat-le-sawmgukte.
english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

paite: Bebai tapate lak ah, Bebai tapa Zekariah; amah toh pasal sawmnih-le-giatte.
english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

paite: Azgad tapate lak ah, Hakkatan tapa Johanan; amah toh pasal za-le-sawmte.
english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.

paite: Adonikam tapate lak ah, ananungpente; hiaite amin uh ahi, Eliphelet, Jeiel, Shemaiah leh amau toh pasal sawmgukte.
english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

paite: Bigvai tapate, Uthai leh Zabbud; amau toh pasal sawmsagihte.
english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

paite: Huchi in Ahava pha a luang luipi tan in amaute ka kaikhawm a; huai ah ni thum ka giak uhi. Mite leh siampute ka en vialvial a, huai ah Levi tapate kuamah ka mu kei.
heading: Tempul A Ding Levi Mi Ezra In Amu
english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.

paite: Huan Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekariah leh Meshullam, mikizen tungtuante, sinsak mite Joiarib leh Elnathan leng ka thukhak hi.
english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.

paite: Kasiphia mun a Iddo hausapa kiang ah amau ka sawlkhia a; Iddo kiang ah leh Kasiphia mun a a-unaute Nethinimte kiang a agen ding uh ka hilh a, i Pathian inn ua ding a nasemmi ei a dia hon tonpih ding in.
english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

paite: Huchi in i tung ua i Pathian khut hoih a om dungzui in pasal khat lunggelsiam, Mahli tapate lak a, Levi tapa, Israel tapa ei ding in Sherebiah atapate leh a-unaute, sawm-le-giat toh ahon pi uhi.
english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

paite: Hashabiah, amah toh Merari tapate lak a Jeshaiah toh, a-unaute leh atapate uh, sawmnih toh;
english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

paite: Nethinimte, David leh avaihawmpihte'n Levi mite nasepna ding a apiakte uh, zanih-le-sawmnih Nethinimte: avek un minkhumna ah akhum uhi.
english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.

paite: Huchi in huai ah, Ahava lui ah, an ngawl ka puang a, huchi a ei a ding leh i nau neute a ding leh i neih i lamte tengteng a dia lampi tang amah lak a zong ding a i Pathian uh ma a ei leh ei i kiniamkhiak theihna ding in.
heading: Ezra In Mipite Thumna Leh An Ngawlna Ah Amakaih
english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

paite: Lampi a melma dou ding a ei hon panpih ding a kumpipa kiang a sepaih pawl leh sakol tungtuangmi nget lah ka zum ngal a: hoihna ding a, amah zongte tung ah i Pathian khut a-om a; himahleh amah mangngilh tengteng siatna ding in athilhihtheihna leh athangpaihna a-om hi, chi a, kumpipa kiang a thu i gen tak ziak in.
english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

paite: An i ngawl ua hiai ding in i Pathian i ngen ngutngut ua: huchi in ama'n i thumna uh hon dawng hi.
english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

paite: Huai lai in siampute lak a amakai lianpente lak a sawm-le-nih, Sherebiah, Hashabiah leh akiang ua om a-unaute uh lak a sawmkhat ka sehkhen a,
heading: Tempul A Dia Thilpiak
english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

paite: amau a ding in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante, kumpipa leh athuhilh mite leh avaihawmpihte'n TOUPA' inn a alatte uh huai lai a om Israel tengteng puak ding in ka buksak hi.
english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.

paite: Akhut sung mahmah uah dangka talent zaguk-le-sawmnga leh dangka tui-um belsuan talent za ka buksak a; dangka-eng lak ah talent za;
english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

paite: dangka-eng noubem sawmnih, darik sangkhat lak ah; dal hoih nawttet, dangka-eng bang a manpha bel nih.
english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "TOUPA a ding in na siangthou ua, tui-um belsuante asiangthou uh; dangka leh dangka-eng TOUPA, na pipute uh Pathian a dia ut thu a thillat ahi uh.
english: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.

paite: TOUPA' inn dantante, Jerusalem a siampute lak a lupente leh Levi mite leh Israel pipute inko vaihawmte ma a huaite na buk masiah uh, pilvan suah in, amaute kem un," ka chi hi.
english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite'n i Pathian inn ua Jerusalem a apuak ding un dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan bukkhiakte ala uhi.
english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

paite: Huai lai in Jerusalem lam a pai ding in, akha khatna ani sawm-le-nih ni in Ahava lui a kipan i pawtkhia ua: huan i Pathian khut i tung uah a-om a, melma khut leh lampi a buk mi a kipan ama'n hon tankheta hi.
heading: Jerusalem A Tun Kik Nawnna
english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem i tung ua huai ah ni thum i om uhi.
english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

paite: Ani li ni in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan i Pathian inn uah Uriah siampu tapa Meremoth khut ah buk in a-om a; akiang ah Phinehas tapa Eleazar a om; akiang uah Jeshua tapa Jozabad leh Binnui tapa Noadiah, Levi mite a-om uhi;
english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

paite: aphazah leh agikdan tengteng sim ahi a, huai hun in laibu a chiamteh ahi.
english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.

paite: Pimangna a kipan a hong pai, saltanna tate'n Israel' Pathian kiang ah halmang thillatte, bawngtal sawm-le-nih Israel tengteng a ding in, belamtal sawmkua-le-guk, belamnou sawmsagih-le-sagih, keltal khelhna thillat ding in sawm-le-nih alan uhi: hiaite tengteng TOUPA a ding a halmang thillat ahi.
english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa thukhen mite kiang leh tuipi khen a ukpipate kiang ah kumpipa thupiakte apekhia ua: huchi in mite leh Pathian inn apanpih uhi.
english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.
